warnings.description: examples/tiled_attention.axc has internally-contradictory comments: line 1-2 honestly mark it WIP with 'GPU numerics incorrect', but lines 22 ('bit-exact for small fixtures') and 31 ('AT-1630: bit-exact within 1e-3 fp tol') are aspirational/design-intent statements that contradict the line-1 disclaimer. No TEST asserts bit-exactness (only spirv-val), so this is a documentation nit, not a dishonest test. Recommend reconciling the in-file comments to match the line-1 WIP status.

AT-1606 shared_reduce.axc runs all 256 lanes of the tree reduction with NO 'if lid < stride' guard. For lid>=128, the index lid+128 is in 256..383, an OUT-OF-BOUNDS read of shared[f32,256]. These OOB results are dead (only tile[0] is written to output), so the final result is unaffected on Lavapipe (verified gpu=384) and lockstep NVIDIA, but the kernel relies on within-step SPIR-V load-before-store ordering and dead-OOB-results. This is a correctness fixture, not a production reduction; the value 384.0 is genuinely correct for THIS kernel and the OOB slots do not corrupt slot 0. Acceptable for a fixture but worth a comment.

item_findings.1_shared_codegen_correctness: PASS — OpTypeArray length is an OpConstant id (get_or_emit_u32_const, shared.rs:133); OpTypePointer Workgroup + OpVariable Workgroup with NO initializer (shared.rs:142-146); SINGLE-index OpAccessChain (shared.rs:177,202), NOT the SSBO two-index. Float16/Int8/Int16/Int64/Float64 capabilities explicitly declared per elem type (shared.rs:119-126) because observe_type does not cover F16 — anti-pattern #7 respected. SPIR-V 1.3 emitted; Workgroup OpVariable correctly excluded from OpEntryPoint interface list (emit.rs guards with debug_assert_eq on version). maxComputeSharedMemorySize preflight wired in context.rs:869 with graceful SharedMemoryExceedsDeviceLimit (not fatal). spirv-val clean: confirmed by compile_shared_examples.rs (passed) AND real Lavapipe pipeline creation in AT-1606 (passed). No invalid SPIR-V path found.
item_findings.2_OQ1_barrier_soundness: PASS — analyze_shared_read_barrier (typecheck.rs:801) tracks a SET of prior write index kinds, cleared at every Barrier (typecheck.rs:1114-1116, 1701-1703). HARD ERROR keyed on ProvablyDisequal-to-ALL (typecheck.rs:820-823), with Check-1 short-circuiting on ProvablyEqual-to-ANY (suppresses the r2 multi-slot bug). index_relation correctly uses LocalRead BindingId Eq, IntLit ty+bits, GidBuiltin axis. r2 multi-slot bug VERIFIED FIXED IN CODE: at1636_multi_slot_self_write_read_back_first_no_diagnostic passes (tile[0]=a;tile[1]=b;read tile[0] -> no diagnostic). False HARD ERROR on correct code is impossible: LocalRead/LocalRead only yields ProvablyEqual|Unknown (never Disequal), so the hard error requires IntLit-distinct or Gid-distinct-axis on EVERY prior write — genuinely cross-slot. Reassigned-binding edge yields at-worst a false ProvablyEqual (suppressed warning = acceptable false negative), never a false hard error.
item_findings.3_OQ2_conditional_depth: PASS — conditional_depth incremented ONLY at if-then and else bodies (typecheck.rs:1297,1309), NOT at while or for-range. Barrier-in-conditional hard error keyed on conditional_depth>0 (typecheck.rs:2409). VERIFIED: at1635_barrier_in_if_body_hard_error (IS errored), at1635_barrier_in_for_range_loop_accepted + at1635_barrier_in_while_loop_accepted (NOT errored). The would-be matmul/attention for-range-body barrier is correctly accepted. AT-429 inversion correct.
item_findings.4_AT1606_load_bearing: PASS — at1606_shared_reduction_barrier_visibility_gpu dispatches shared_reduce.axc on a real GPU and asserts 384.0. RAN ON LAVAPIPE: gpu_result=384, cpu_result=384, PASS. 384.0 is the MATHEMATICALLY CORRECT value: input=[0..255]; step0 (stride=128): tile[0]=input[0]+input[128]=0+128=128, tile[64]=input[64]+input[192]=64+192=256; step1 (stride=64): tile[0]=tile[0]+tile[64]=128+256=384. = 0+128+64+192. Genuinely load-bearing (a broken shared/barrier path would not produce 384).
item_findings.5_honest_deferral: PASS — grep confirms the ONLY dispatch_handle + numeric assert in dispatch_shared_m32.rs is AT-1606 (shared_reduce). The 4 converted tests (at1621/at1620/at1622/at1630) are compile + spirv-val ONLY; matmul/attention NEVER dispatched with a numeric assertion. compile_shared_examples.rs is compile+spirv-val only. The WIP coopmat resident bench (AT-1623) was honestly REMOVED (resident_matmul.rs:582) to avoid misleading TFLOPS for a zero-computing kernel. No misleading TFLOPS number for the WIP kernels (common_matmul.rs TFLOPS infra is pre-existing M3.1 and only asserts >0 && finite).

most_dangerous_remaining_issue: examples/tiled_attention.axc carries internally-contradictory comments claiming 'bit-exact within 1e-3' (lines 22/31) while line 1 honestly marks it GPU-incorrect WIP. No test asserts the bit-exactness, so it is not a dishonest test, but a future reader or autotuner could be misled by the in-file claim. Recommend reconciling those comments in M3.3.
summary: M3.2 (re-scoped to shared[T,N]) APPROVED. The shared[T,N] codegen emits valid SPIR-V (OpConstant array length, Workgroup OpVariable no-initializer, single-index access chain, explicit Float16 capability, correct interface-list exclusion for SPIR-V 1.3) — verified spirv-val clean AND executed bit-exact (gpu=384, the mathematically correct value) on Lavapipe. The OQ1 SET-based missing-barrier analysis is SOUND IN CODE: the r2 multi-slot false-positive is genuinely fixed (ProvablyEqual-to-ANY suppresses), and a false HARD ERROR on correct code is structurally impossible (hard error only on ProvablyDisequal-to-ALL via IntLit/Gid, never via LocalRead). OQ2 conditional_depth is if/else-only; for-range/while barriers accepted, if-body barrier errored (AT-429 inverted correctly). The deferral is honest: only AT-1606 dispatches with a numeric assert; the 4 WIP tests are compile+spirv-val only; the WIP coopmat bench was removed rather than report misleading TFLOPS; no hidden-failing ignored test (23/0 on Lavapipe). Buffer coopmat path is byte-identical (91 ins/0 del, AT-1613 green). Metadata v3 back-compat is sound (allowed-set {1,2,3}, v4 rejected, no garbage admitted). No UB, no races, no regressions. Two non-blocking warnings: contradictory bit-exact comments in tiled_attention.axc, and an unguarded (but dead-result) OOB read in the shared_reduce fixture.
